financed_growth_gate.interpretation: Customer advances and strong deliveries materially improve operating cash, but growth remains capital intensive and partially debt/financing funded. Positive CFO must not be treated as free cash flow while capex exceeds RMB10bn in H1.

thesis.core: The fundamental inflection is real and exceptional: the inserted Hengli shipbuilding assets are converting a large order book into revenue, margin and cash flow, with 2026H1 earnings already above 2025 full-year profit. This is not a momentum-only story.
thesis.variant_wedge: The share price has moved far ahead of a conservative through-cycle valuation. At the latest complete close, investors are effectively paying for sustained high-cycle margins, order conversion and successful capital-intensive capacity expansion simultaneously.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use RMB6.5bn attributable net profit as base 2026/through-cycle transition earnings, below simple H1 annualization (~RMB7.2bn) to reflect shipbuilding cycle, delivery timing, financing/depreciation burden and margin normalization risk.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base sits below H1 annualization but well above 2025, recognizing backlog/scale while hair-cutting current peak mix and margin.

catalysts: 207 H1 new ship orders and subsequent orders convert into high-margin deliveries without execution slippage.
High-value tanker/container/VLAC mix sustains H1 margin improvement.
New yard/engine capacity reaches high utilization without cost overruns.
Contract liabilities continue converting into revenue while debt growth moderates.
kill_thesis: New-build price/margin cycle rolls over before the expanded capacity reaches mature utilization.
Order cancellations, delivery delays or raw-material/FX cost pressure reduce normalized margins materially.
Debt and finance expense grow faster than project earnings and customer advances.
Capex remains structurally above operating cash generation after the current expansion phase.
At prices requiring the bull case to justify value, valuation remains a standing rejection gate.

d2_answers.question: Determine whether trend persistence is supported by durable fundamental change rather than expectations alone.
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue was RMB23.504bn (+251.87%), attributable net profit RMB3.609bn (+457.67%), recurring profit RMB3.514bn (+2935.31%), and operating cash flow RMB8.509bn versus negative RMB0.202bn a year earlier. The company added 207 ship orders in H1; high-value container/tanker orders exceeded 70% of the new-order mix.
d2_answers.interpretation: The trend is supported by a genuine post-restructuring earnings and order-book step change. However, the magnitude is amplified by a favorable global shipbuilding cycle and rapid capacity ramp.

d2_answers.question: Test whether the expected return remains attractive after normalizing current momentum.
d2_answers.fact: The latest complete close was RMB183.48 with about 1.019bn shares, implying roughly RMB187bn equity value. Even simple H1 annualization (~RMB7.22bn earnings) implies about 25.9x P/E.
d2_answers.assumption: Bear/base/bull values use RMB4.5bn/6.5bn/8.0bn normalized profit at 15x/20x/25x P/E, respectively.
d2_answers.interpretation: Probability-weighted value is about RMB129/share, roughly 29% below market. Current valuation requires outcomes close to the bull case and leaves little protection against cycle or execution normalization.

d2_answers.question: Normalize earnings and cash flow using the latest primary financial disclosures.
d2_answers.fact: 2025 attributable net profit was about RMB2.655bn. 2026H1 attributable net profit was RMB3.609bn. H1 operating cash flow improved to RMB8.509bn, but investing cash flow was -RMB10.128bn and cash capex on fixed/intangible/long-term assets was RMB10.160bn. Short-term borrowings rose to RMB10.597bn and finance expense rose materially.
d2_answers.interpretation: Earnings quality is much stronger than 2025, but free-cash-flow quality is not equivalent to headline CFO because customer advances and heavy growth capex are both large. Base normalized profit of RMB6.5bn recognizes the step-up while retaining financing/cycle haircuts.

d2_answers.question: Build an explicit valuation range and identify what expectations are embedded in the current price.
d2_answers.fact: H1 attributable equity was RMB13.060bn against assets RMB74.611bn; contract liabilities were RMB12.037bn and short-term borrowings RMB10.597bn.
d2_answers.assumption: Bear/base/bull equity values are RMB66.24/RMB127.58/RMB196.27 per share.
d2_answers.interpretation: At RMB183.48 the stock sits near the bull-case value. The market is pricing sustained high margins, large-order conversion, high utilization of new capacity and manageable financing simultaneously.

d2_answers.question: Define the first-rejection test and the evidence that would invalidate the thesis.
d2_answers.judgment: The fundamental half is NOT triggered; the valuation half IS decisively triggered for promotion. Full D2 research is complete, but no promotion is warranted at the current price. Reopen only after a major earnings/ROIC upgrade or a large price reset. Thesis invalidates if backlog converts with lower margins, capex/debt outrun cash generation, or shipbuilding pricing/order conditions roll over.
